Deterministic ECDSA (0x0101, 0x0108, native EVM keys, transactions) is RFC 6979 with extraEntropy: false passed explicitly and low-s. scaas Schnorr nonce: k = hashToScalar(keccak256("scaas.ua.schnorr.nonce.v1" ‖ be32(sk) ‖ Y ‖ ua_msg ‖ aux)), the 512-bit map (nonceMap). typed: generic = the faithful EIP-712 hasher (missing field = zero, unknown field refused, int two's complement, T[k]); canon = the SCaaS builders, whose unbound relayer / feeRecipient hash as zero (nested too); policy = expectDigest(td, expect) over the check* functions. tx: evmTransaction types 0-3 (no type 4), signTransaction. webauthn: webauthnAssertion against the expected challenge. msig: msigMemberSigs, minimal at both levels. chainSeparation (owner 2026-11-05): one message and one key on chain 7622 (SCaaS testnet) and 22776 (SCaaS mainnet): a UAMetaTransfer in a token domain with chainId (UA key 0x0108, signUA metatx) and EIP-155 transactions of types 0 and 2 (the EVM key) give other digests and signatures per chain; refusals: a signature for one chain does not verify against the other's digest; portable: a record in the portable domain (no chainId) is one digest and one signature on both.
